observations: Photo 0: White sewing machine on a table base; brand text visible on the left side reads “TOYOTA”.
Photo 0: Blue control panel with stitch/setting markings; a handwheel/knob area visible on the right.
Photo 1: Same sewing machine from a different angle; “TOYOTA” text still visible.
Photos show the machine body and table top; no clear view of model number, accessories, or manual pages.

claims.claim: Preloved sewing table top machine available for sale.
claims.evidence: Photos show a used-looking table-top sewing machine (no packaging).
Photos only show “TOYOTA” branding; no country-of-origin label is readable.
No video/audio test of the motor running is provided.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show accessories or the manual.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service history or internal inspection is shown.

risks.risk: Whether it actually sews properly (timing, needle bar movement, feed, tension) even if the motor sounds fine.
risks.proof: A short video of it sewing a straight line on fabric (with needle + thread installed) showing consistent feed and no skipping.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully proven/untested performance (use the lowest comparable).

risks.proof: A clear photo laid out showing every accessory included (presser feet, bobbins, needles, spool pin, power cord, etc.) plus the manual cover/pages.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as incomplete kit (use the lowest comparable).

risks.risk: Country-of-origin and exact model may differ from what’s claimed; “TOYOTA” could be a rebrand/variant.
risks.proof: Photo of the rating plate/model sticker (bottom/back) showing model number and country of manufacture.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as a generic preowned table-top sewing machine (lowest comparable).

risks.risk: Electrical/power issues (cord damage, switch faults) not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Video showing power-on, speed control response, and stable operation for a few minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as needing basic checks (lowest comparable).

proof_requests: Send a video of the machine sewing on fabric (straight stitch) with thread + needle installed.
Show a full laid-out photo of all accessories included and the original manual (cover + a page).
Take a clear close-up photo of the rating plate/model sticker (bottom/back) showing model number and country of manufacture.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a TOYOTA table-top sewing machine, but key seller claims (motor performance, completeness of accessories/manual, and no issues) are not verifiable remotely; so it should be priced at the worst case using the cheapest matching comparable.
